newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BONTON CHOOSES MORGAN STANLEY TO LEAD IPO.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BONTON CHOOSES MORGAN STANLEY TO LEAD IPO.

text.p: Czech entertainment group Holding Bonton a.s. on Friday said it had chosen investment bank Morgan Stanley to lead its initial public offering (IPO), expected in the second half of this year.

Holding Bonton Financial Director Jan Vinter said the amount of the IPO has yet to be set, but that he expected it to total "around $50 million". Holding Bonton's basic capital currently stands at some 270 million crowns.

"The basic capital should rise by about double, and the rest of the money raised by the issue should go into our investment activity," he said adding that between 70-80 percent of the issue to be placed in foreign hands.
He said the shares will be listed on the Prague Stock Exchange sometime in 1998.
A Bonton official recently said that the issue price for the IPO should be about four or five times the 1,000 crown nominal value of the shares.
